scenarios.title: Decision branch coverage
scenarios.reason: Every reachable decision requires positive and negative evidence.

scenarios.title: Concurrent state mutation
scenarios.reason: State mutation requires deterministic conflict behavior.

scenarios.title: Runtime context isolation
scenarios.reason: Ambient context must become explicit and isolated.

scenarios.title: External dependency failure
scenarios.reason: Dependency failure policy must be replayed.

scenarios.title: Web/RPC entrypoint parity
scenarios.reason: guards split behavior across compatibility endpoints

scenarios.title: Primary successful execution
scenarios.reason: Every endpoint requires one complete successful replay.

scenarios.title: Query cache response isolation
scenarios.reason: Per-request response enrichment must not mutate cached baseline objects.

scenarios.title: Query-side effect atomicity and replay
scenarios.reason: Query-time writes require rollback and idempotent replay evidence.

scenarios.title: Query timeout task quiescence
scenarios.reason: Timed-out query work must not produce effects after the response returns.

scenarios.title: Request semantic override parity
scenarios.reason: Request overrides must preserve or explicitly approve the legacy fixed semantic.

scenarios.title: Scale and performance boundary
scenarios.reason: Target execution must meet an explicit resource budget.

scenarios.title: Standard first-page query
scenarios.reason: baseline request/response shape for the endpoint

scenarios.title: Transaction failure and rollback
scenarios.reason: Partial writes and rollback must be observable.

scenarios.title: Validation rejection
scenarios.reason: Validation behavior must match before target ownership.

waves.title: Make runtime contracts explicit
waves.objective: Replace ambient context and implicit effects with explicit contracts.

waves.title: Move deterministic behavior
waves.objective: Port validation, decisions and calculation behind parity tests.

waves.title: Introduce infrastructure ports
waves.objective: Isolate state and external systems behind target-neutral ports.

waves.title: Move orchestration and observable effects
waves.objective: Transfer transaction, event and compensation ownership.

waves.title: Cut over and prove source-off
waves.objective: Route directly to the target and execute rollback drills.
